reviews.text: Extremely helpful. I actually like this app better than the official 75 hard app. I’ve purchased that one and I keep going back to this one. I just feel like it’s more user-friendly and more simplified. It does not necessarily support phase one the way that the other one does, but It’s just easier to navigate if you have restart or wanna go back and look at one more pictures. I use this for when they did the challenge in 2022 and I’m using it again four years later and it’s been great.

reviews.text:
No Edit Option. ETA: I recognize that it is “clearly stated”, but for a paid version of an app, there should really be an option to modify the time.

I’ve used this app for tracking before, but this round I accidentally set the completion time to 7:30 a.m. instead of 7:30 p.m. There seems to be no option to fix this so every day at 7:30 a.m., it says I failed my tasks. I’ve also paid for the ad-free option to see if that would fix it, but it doesn’t and I don’t even see a way to sign out and create a new account.

Could be better. Been using this app a while. It’s not bad for essentially being free. I’m not paying 1.99 because I’m not sure it’ll be worth it. My problems with it are ….. 1. It freezes all the time and sometimes won’t let me click which habit I did. Even though I keep app updated. I’m constantly closing out and re-entering it. 2. I hate seeing failed attempts. It’s so disheartening and not motivating. I wish there was a way to clear past attempts instead getting a new email.

Please update. I think this is a great app I really do wish there was an option to challenge friends to join and complete the challenge with you. Even a friends feature where you could track your friends progress who’s accepted the invite as well . That was sent this app over the top. Want to do this with your friends and stay motivated and be able to see the progress. Similar to Apple Watch or Apple Fitness or Maps allow you to add friends and view progress with each other. Compete for challenges motivate, and keep each other accountable.

reviews.text:
Great way to track 75 Hard tasks. I’ve been doing 75 Hard for 47 days now. I can’t tell you how much this app has helped. I paid the $1.99 to remove the ads right away after I saw how easy the app was to use. 

It gives a reminder an hour before you set the end of your day so you can double check that everything was done. A couple of times early on it made me realize I hadn’t read or was missing a picture (which are two of the most common ways to fail). 

The developer is really helpful and easy to get in touch with. I had a question about moving progress from one phone to another and he fixed me up less than half an hour after messaging him. 

Recommend this app to anyone trying to complete 75 Hard!
Feeling Wonderful. I love this app, it’s wonderful at keeping me mindful of drinking water throughout the day.
75Hard!!!. Do it because you can!! And this app is just the right to help you track and get there!

App freezes and doesn’t not allow you to move forward.. I forgot to complete my day prior on the app. It gives you the option to select “I completed my tasks”, “I failed” or to “upgrade for 1.99”. It will only allow me to select I failed or upgrade so I will no longer be using it since it’s making me start over.

Enrollment email never sent. Couldn’t ever log in after multiple attempts to have it send me an email. Not worth it. 

Edited to add: gmail account

Great App and Customer Service!. Great app that helps keep track of 75 hard.L and has great customer service. I had and issue with a bug on a Saturday morning that resulted in a failed day. I reached out and by that afternoon it’s was fixed and by the next week the bug was completely fixed altogether. Several times I forgot to check all the task that I completed and decided to pay for the app and it was definitely worth it! No adds and easy to restore those day when I forgot to check off task.

Great app for tracking progress. Been using this app every day so far to track my tasks. Super easy and light weight. Shows days completed and remaining task for each day. Has a reminder feature you can use as well so you don’t forget. 

Encountered a minor bug that caused it to skip a day but I reached out to the support developer and he fixed it within an hour for me! Was very surprised at how quickly he reached back with a solution.

Updated Review. Originally I gave the app a 2 Star rating due to getting to day 40 and it began skipping ahead a day at time. Developer responded and quickly did an update to fix the bug and was able to update my status. Very glad to have the app again. Great response time. Can fully recommend the app now!!

So far, so good!. I am on Day 9 and I really love this app so far. It is pretty user friendly and has everything you need to keep track of your 75 Hard journey. It has very few frills and it seems to be an absolute workhorse so far. I especially like the ‘view progression’ feature on the photo uploads.

I had one small bug but I reached out to the developer via Facebook and had a response and a fix in less than 30 minutes. Excellent customer service.

I highly recommend!

Great app. This will keep you on track and help you consolidate your tasks - been using it since 2021 during the program. It had some bugs recently but they were fixed fast and was able to get back on track. Stop overthinking and use this one and get to work. 

Very grateful for this app.

Crashes Daily…Horrible. This app crashes daily, jumps ahead days and overall will not help you. You would be better off downloading the 75 Hard app it works everyday! Don’t waist your $1.99. Not worth it. It should be zero stars. Horrible.

Love the app this far, but it glitched. I love the app so far. Easy to use. I would love to see an upload function for completion to anything other than instagram. I don’t use instagram so I have to take a screenshot. It did glitch on me though. I started 10 days ago. Completed my 9 last night. But when I opened the app this morning, on day 10, it said I failed to complete my photo upload? I was confused. I watched the obligatory video and it said I am on day 11 now? I don’t know what happened. Other than this glitch, I am happy with the app.
Good App!. Been using the app for about 3 weeks now and any question or problem I’ve had has been taken care of in a professional and timely manner!! Definitely recommend!

Doesn’t work. Won’t progress to the next day- which is so frustrating!! And before the developer says “the bug is fixed” I’ve updated the app and deleted it and it still won’t move to the next day. Find a different app because this one doesn’t work.

Won’t let me progress. Please reach out to me, I’m on day 19 and it won’t let me progress to the next day. This is extremely frustrating because I don’t want to lose all my progress on my first time trying this challenge.

Not only a great app but incredible response time!!. I started this app 5 days in to the actual program and needed to “catch up” for tracking purposes. Reached out to the Touch Habits team and had a response and resolution within the hour!!
Doesn’t work. My app isn’t working. Stays on the same day. Tried deleting and downloading again. More than once. Disappointed.

Now I’m a Day Off. My app just skipped a day. I’d think maybe I forgot to log a day, but my picture was taken and saved yesterday, yet the app shows that as the picture for two days ago.

Thanks for the response, Justin. When I went back in the following day, it showed my day as done, but now I am no longer a day off. However, the day I wasn’t able to load a picture, I forgot to take one and so now I’ve messed up my whole challenge. :(
Great customer support. I had an issue with my time and needed a reset - I reached out and had someone reach back immediately to resolve my issue!
74 Hard Challenge. I’m very much satisfied. No issues.

Awesome App & Great Customer Service. Such a great app when taking on the Hard75 (or subsequent phases). Love the progression fade from your Day 1 photo to your current day pic!!!

Thanks to your Facebook Customer Service team for fixing a bug (VERY QUICKLY) for me when I had an issue.

Can’t say enough good things - if you are ready to start your fitness/mental toughness journey: GET THIS APP!
Stops after day 5. Is it only free before Day 6?! WTH. I’m putting in all this work and the app keeps closing down on me. I will not recommend this to others. Just pay for the original

Love love love this App!. Doing 75 hard is really challenging and this app is super helpful! Helps me keep track of where I am and all my tasks! Also the customer service is fast and efficient! I payed the 1.99 to avoid adds and it is sooo worth it! 🔥💪🏾
Best app ever!. This app has been a game changer. Not only can I track my progress and add my own goals, but the customer service is top notch! Don’t hesitate to download!
Love but won’t stay open. Today on day 9 and it opens for 2 seconds the disappears

5 stars all day, every day!!!! 😀. Tough Habits is the BEST app I have ever found to track 75Hard daily data! The upload process for the photos is extreme seamless, all your goals are completely editable, and the final product can be shared to Instagram in one click.

75Hard fans: This the ONLY app you should be using to compile your progress! The graphics are great and the app owner personally replies to all inquires, and even went to extensive lengths to help me recover my old account when I got a new phone!

5 stars all day, every day!!!! 😀
Great. It helps a lot to get healthy habit especially when you challenge you friends to how long you can go

It is helpful.. I like the app and think it is helpful. I do want to stop the daily timer, because I started using the app one day late. This means I have to wait until the end of the day to put everything in. It is helpful with the accountability and reminders to make sure I got everything in as well. Thanks for creating it!

Appreciate your quick response. I would like to change my daily time on my app. Thanks!

Keep Me Locked 🔒 In. Keep me locked in and focus and keep me on track!
Great Support!!. Support team is top notch! They respond fairly quickly and are super friendly. Thanks for your patience, especially with a new user!

Worked wonderfully for my 75 Hard. Simple to use and perfect for helping my complete my 75 hard (on my first try)! Lost a life and don’t have Facebook. First I very much appreciate a free version of the app. I was very much enjoying the app until I went to add my last two tasks tonight and my app expressed that I had failed. reviews.text:
I’m all about off brand support.. WE all know this is similar to another app, however, I’m all about supporting the basics and things that are JUST AS GOOD IF NOT BETTER than the hyped up version of something. 
 
This goes for blenders, apps, shoes all kinds of things in my life. And I have had great success with researching products and finding better prices and most of the time better quality and customer service out of it all. Sometimes the “big names” don’t have that personal touch.

This is where this app rises all the perks + customer service. THANK YOU!

Super responsive when it comes to fixing the app. I was having an issue (ended up being IO error) HOWEVER, the resolution helped me keep my phone settings and not have to switch them. They fixed the issue and now I can finish my LAST DAY! (I'll be doing it again) -- I hope they add some "30 day" challenges in there as well that we can complete. I love that they have the ability to add your own habits and challenges. The paid version is worth it!

Excellent app, amazing support. This app is very user friendly and easy to use. I bought because I liked the look and feel and the ability to add additional tasks to customize the challenge. Had a slight hiccup and reached out to the support, problem was fixed and working within 10 Minutes! Talk about amazing. I highly recommend!

Definitely worth the $1.99. Doing this challenge I wanted to be able to track it throughout my day so paper wasn’t going to be efficient. So glad this app was created. I made it about 12 days without upgrading and paying the $1.99 to avoid ads and honestly it was totally worth it. 75 days and potentially hundreds of ads you’d have to go through...? I’d rather support the creator than waste that much time. The only thing that drives me a bit crazy is the progress photo section. If I take a pic from the ap it doesn’t allow me to move/adjust where it decides it wants to crop. If I load in my photo from my phone it still crops it really strangely and close which makes it hard for me to be able to take a step back and REALLY gauge/observe progress. Guess I’ll just stick to other photo apps for those purposes. All in all: thank you!
Update: went from 4-5 stars cause I still do think this it totally worth it and don’t want to dissuade anyone from using or purchasing the upgrade on this app. I’m impressed that the developer actually cares about the user feedback.

Good app but why 3 lives?. I’ve used both this and the 75 Hard app. Here’s what I like better about this app-You can see you progress easily with a comparison from day 1 to current day photo. It tells you have far through the program you are in a percentage. It also tells you how much time is left in your day. It’s also less expensive. What I don’t like about this app is that there are 3 lives. There are no lives in 75 Hard. If you miss a task you start back on day 1. Change that and I would give it a 5 star rating.

reviews.text: Help!. I started this challenge two days ago, today I wake up and the app won’t open. Will it save all my stuff from the last two days?

75 Tough. This app is great for keeping track of your progress while completing the 75 hard challenge. The app did skip a day and showed that I hadn’t completed day 17 and skipped to day 18 (resulting in a loss of a life). I contacted customer service and they fixed it immediately! I would definitely recommend! BrittanyV

Great app, great customer service.. This app has been instrumental for me being successful in the challenge. It’s simple and easy to use. I screwed up on one of the days and I reached out to the developer to help me fix it. They were quick to respond and were able to fix things from their end. I always appreciate such prompt and effective customer service.

Great customer service!. This app works really well! I had a slight problem when it glitched but I reached out to customer support and they had the problem solved within an hour or so. Now I can get back to me challenge!
Worthless. Makes you create an account with email address then asks you to login with a username that it never gives you. Deleted.

Awesome response to inquiries. Yes the App is well laid out and easy to use. I am even more impressed by the response when there is a question or a challenge!! Kind, efficient and just plain on it!!! LOVE LOVE LOVE

The Real Deal. This app is just what the doctor ordered!
I’ve always in the past been successful when I had a blueprint in front of me.. This is cut and dry, you know what you have to complete. As you check off the boxes it’s an overwhelmingly good feeling.
You can personalize the program however you’d like to and work within that. You can also add personal challenges. I’m doing it with my niece which is great , having an accountability partner is a plus. But I think it’d be equally great solo.
On the road to my best life! Best wishes to you!

Top notch customer service!. I got into some tech glitch, left the developer some description about it. In almost no time, the developer reached back to me, and fixed my issue right away. After a little chat, I appreciate more his intention to help streamline the program. He’s come a long way. Let’s support his kindness and dedication by making our community bigger and tougher.

Effective, overall would recommend. This is effective. But a few things I would modify if I could- I don’t like uploading photos. Where are they stored? I wish you could log water throughout the day (to help keep track). I also wouldn’t mind being able to establish a reminder/notification at a specific time (like 8 PM, for example) to ensure you logged everything before going to bed. 

Overall, this is helpful and I would recommend this app.

UPDATE: I forgot to tick off my pages yesterday in the app (but I completed them) and now it says FAILED. And the day is red. While there are “lives” built into the app (so you can continue) aesthetically it says FAILED and that is a slap in the face. You should be able to adjust something if you neglected to put it in the app the day before. Again, allowing reminders at a designated time appropriate for each individual would be helpful. (I seem to get a notification around 11 PM, but go to sleep around 9 PM because that is MY schedule). Would not recommend if you are someone that isn’t glued to technology.

reviews.text: The App / Customer Service. The App works well and is worth the free download or even the pro version compared to that other $5 app. Haven’t had any issues on my journey thus far. However I’m leaving this review solely because the customer support is impeccably efficient. I hate leaving reviews because I find it annoying and I’m busy, but I was thankful for the quick response after I wasn’t able to log something due to my phone being dead. Great customer service! Keep it up!

reviews.text:
Great tracker & amazing tech support!. * allows for adding 3 personal challenges
* user friendly to check off daily activities and see progress 
* like another user, I failed to check off my day 8 before the time cut off, and was able to “edit progression” to complete it 
* affordable!

Meh. The app and idea in itself is pretty good, very motivating and challenging.
I missed checking off an item on my day 4, and there is no way to go back and edit the day. It now shows that I failed the day. Very discouraging to look at that day as a failure when I know I completed it. I am trying to commit myself to the program, which takes up considerable time.
I will just make myself a pen and paper chart and delete and stop using the app. 
I’ve read in other posts that tech support can help you fix it, but I already don’t have the time to check off all the actions per day, never mind putting in tech support tickets.

“User name not found”. This app is broke. I tried to register twice and each time, after I completed all the steps, and was ready to log in I received a error message.
